digest.component_or_area: link relations and ticket graph model
propositions: Add `caused_by` as a 7th directional link relation to express causal bug provenance, following the `discovered_from` precedent (non-blocking, non-cycle-inducing, Jira-unmapped).
The hardcoded tuple at src/rebar/graph/_graph.py line ~204 must include `caused_by` in the non-blocking relations set or it will incorrectly receive blocking-cycle semantics.
The relation must be added to the schema enum, generated types, _links.py CANONICAL_RELATIONS, and CLI help/golden snapshots to maintain consistency across the codebase.
A `caused_by` link must not block ticket resolution or induce cycle violations, allowing two-node cycles and non-blocking graph traversal.
Old LINK events without the `caused_by` relation must continue to reduce without error (backward compatibility).
